title: AI Ethics and Social Norms: Exploring ChatGPT’s Capabilities From What to How
benchmark_measurement: The paper did not use a specific benchmark to measure religion. Instead, through qualitative interviews, it captured the perception of some participants (specifically from Iran) that LLMs should be influenced by local religious and cultural ideologies to avoid being dominated by globalized Western ideologies.
findings: A number of Iranian participants noted that religious and cultural ideologies should influence LLM outputs; otherwise, globalized Western ideologies might overshadow smaller cultures, potentially causing them to disappear over time. This highlights a desire for LLMs to be sensitive to local norms rather than defaulting to a perceived Western perspective.
